title: PTPGE quote/1
description: A printer's answer to one request: the same configuration and the same ptpge-cfs/1 fingerprint it was asked for, a quantity, a price in one currency, delivery terms and a validity period, addressed to the buyer who asked. Together with the request it is one deal; its acceptance is the event an implementation acts on. The fingerprint is what ties the two documents together without a system in between — a quote whose spec fingerprint differs from the request's is an offer for something else. Not published at a known path — it has a recipient. Licence of the schema: CC BY 4.0.

id.description: The printer's reference for this quote.

validUntil.description: The last day the quote may be accepted.

vendor.description: The printer's register identity — the party that will deliver.

request.description: The request's id, as the buyer gave it.

fingerprint.description: The request's spec fingerprint. Must equal fingerprint.spec below.

The identities this quote answers and mints (ptpge-cfs/1, SD-0108): spec and request repeat the request's; offer = request plus variables/order/vendor (this printer's identity) — one per vendor, computed by the printer, kept by the two parties.

alternatives.description: The same configuration at other run lengths.

conditions.description: What the price assumes: artwork state, proofing, payment terms.

price.description: One currency, amounts as decimal numbers excluding VAT unless vatIncluded says otherwise.
